'''Soronna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] at the [[Kragget/Legends|Kragget]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], an all-[[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="O66" />

When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was implemented, Soronna helped [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] by giving her a change of clothes.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soronna first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Republic Commando: Triple Zero|''Triple Zero'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 28]], [[2006]]. She went unnamed in ''Triple Zero'', however, and did so again when she made subsequent appearances in ''Triple Zero''{{'s}} sequel, [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], published on [[October 30]], [[2007]]. The character was finally identified as Soronna in Traviss' fourth entry in the ''Republic Commando'' series, [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], published [[September 16]], [[2008]].
